products.name: OneTrust AI Governance
products.note: Privacy-first approach; strong data governance; compliance automation; good for privacy-primary orgs

profile_text.body:
OneTrust is a software company that helps organizations manage privacy, consent, data governance, and AI compliance. Its platform is described on its own site as connecting privacy, data, AI, and technology risk in a single continuous system, with the stated aim of automating assessments, enforcing controls, and monitoring risks across domains. The company positions its tooling as a way to embed governance into existing data and AI workflows rather than adding friction to them.

The company's primary AI product tracked by this site is OneTrust AI Governance, categorized under AI Governance and Risk Management Platforms. The site markets it under the name the OneTrust AI-Ready Governance Platform, describing capabilities that include defining purpose, automating risk assessments, enforcing controls, and providing continuous real-time visibility into how data and AI are used. The product is noted for a privacy-first approach and compliance automation, and is characterized as particularly suited to organizations where privacy is the primary governance concern.

The site includes a testimonial from GOL Trust for Aviation, which describes using OneTrust to manage data privacy, third-party relationships, risk assessments, and compliance workflows, citing the challenge of handling what it describes as seven billion IDs across its storage database and thousands of vendors and systems. No litigation, SEC filings, patent records, or MCP server registrations are present in the held facts for OneTrust.
